device.connect.message: Allow {name} ({host}) to run commands on this computer?
device.connect.message_host: Allow {host} to run commands on this computer?
device.connect.detail: This computer becomes a local device of the platform: agents can run commands here, and the platform reviews every command. On a new setup every command runs in the sandbox: nothing runs outside it until you allow that on this computer, sandboxed commands can reach the public internet (private and local addresses stay closed), and only the device's own working directory is in reach. It keeps serving as a login service after you close the app, and keeps the computer awake while operations run. You can disconnect it from the menu bar icon at any time.
device.disconnect_other.message: This computer is connected to {origin}. Disconnect it first?
device.disconnect_other.detail: Disconnecting stops the local device there and logs it out on this computer. The device stays registered on that platform until someone deletes it.
device.resume.message: Let {name} ({host}) run commands on this computer again?
device.resume.message_host: Let {host} run commands on this computer again?
device.resume.detail: This computer accepts the platform's operations again and keeps running as a login service.
device.keep_awake.message: Keep this computer awake more often?
device.keep_awake.detail.while-busy: While operations run, this computer will not go to idle sleep.
device.keep_awake.detail.connected: While the device is connected, this computer never goes to idle sleep; it uses more power and a laptop in a bag can get warm.
device.keep_awake.limits: Keep-awake cannot prevent sleep when the lid of a Mac on battery is closed without an external display, when Sleep is chosen, at a critically low battery or in a thermal emergency. A sleeping computer is offline for the platform.
device.remove.message: Also disconnect this computer and log the device out?
device.remove.detail: This computer is connected to {platform} as a local device. Choose No to keep the device running.
device.ceiling.change.project_reach: Project reach: the whole OS user (os-user)
device.keep_awake.limits_linux: Keep-awake cannot prevent sleep from the lid switch as the system handles it, when Sleep is chosen, at a critically low battery or in a thermal emergency. A sleeping computer is offline for the platform.
update.ready.title: A new version of {name} is ready
update.ready.body: {version} has been downloaded and installs when you quit. Click to restart and update now.
platform.remove.detail: This signs you out of the platform on this computer and deletes its local data (cookies, cache). You can add it again later.
onboarding.connect.title: Connect to your platform
onboarding.connect.lead: Enter the platform address your organization gave you. You sign in in your browser.
onboarding.connect.label: Platform address
onboarding.connect.error.unreachable: Can’t reach {host}. Check the address for typos, and that your network or VPN is connected.
onboarding.connect.error.not_capybara: This address is not a Capybara platform. Check that it is the address your organization gave you.
onboarding.connect.error.too_old: This platform’s version is too old for desktop sign-in. Ask your platform admin to upgrade it.
onboarding.connect.error.not_https: Only https addresses can be connected (except localhost on this computer).
onboarding.connect.error.cert_invalid: The certificate is invalid, so {host} can’t be reached securely. Contact your platform admin.
onboarding.connect.error.invalid: This is not a valid address.
onboarding.connect.error.locked: Your administrator has not allowed this platform.
onboarding.found.title: Sign in to {platform}
onboarding.found.hint: Opens the sign-in page in your default browser, where passwords, single sign-on and password managers work as usual. You come back here by yourself when you’re done.
onboarding.waiting.title: Finish signing in in your browser
onboarding.waiting.lead: Once you confirm “Sign in on {machine}” in your browser, you come back here automatically.
onboarding.waiting.step.confirm: Waiting for you to confirm in the browser
onboarding.waiting.step.return: Back here, into a new conversation
onboarding.signIn.error.timeout: Sign-in timed out (not finished within 10 minutes). Just start again.
onboarding.signIn.error.cancelled: You cancelled sign-in in the browser.
onboarding.signIn.error.not_allowed: This platform doesn’t allow desktop sign-in yet. Ask your platform admin to turn it on.
onboarding.signIn.error.account_unusable: This account can’t sign in to {platform}: it may be disabled or not in any organization. Sign in with another account, or contact your platform admin.
onboarding.signIn.error.link_invalid: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start signing in again from here.
onboarding.signedOut.title: Signed out of {platform}
onboarding.signedOut.device: This computer is still connected as a device
onboarding.signedOut.accountDevice: {account} · This computer is still connected as a device
onboarding.signedOut.signIn: Sign in again with your browser
mainError.expired.title: Your session has expired
mainError.expired.lead: Sign in again to return to the page you were on.
mainError.expired.signIn: Sign in again with your browser
mainError.expired.waiting: Confirm the sign-in in your browser; you’ll return to the page you were on.
mainError.unreachable.title: Can’t reach the platform right now
mainError.unreachable.lead: It may be upgrading or under maintenance, or your network or VPN dropped. You return to the page you were on once it’s back.
signOut.title: Sign out of {platform}?
signOut.detail: This computer stays connected as a device, and running tasks are not affected. To disconnect the device, use the device page.
